prompt: A visitor on the bench wants to read every caption in larger print. What should a volunteer do?
promptZh: 坐在長椅上的訪客想看所有展品說明的大字版。志工應怎麼做？
evidence: “The large-print card on it gives only the main points, not the entire captions.” / “Enlarged copies of the full captions are in the drawer by the table.” / “You can take a copy to anyone who wants to stay seated.”
explanationZh: 抽屜裡的版本是完整內容且字體放大，拿給訪客就能在長椅上讀到所有說明。

options.text: Ask the visitor to read the large-print card already on the bench.
options.zh: 請訪客讀長椅上原本放著的大字版卡片。
options.whyZh: 長椅上的卡片雖是大字版，卻只有重點，不能讓訪客讀到所有內容。

options.text: Read just the captions’ main points aloud and leave the card on the bench.
options.zh: 只念出展品說明的重點，把卡片留在長椅上。
options.whyZh: 朗讀重點仍不是完整說明，也無法讓訪客自行讀到想看的大字內容。

options.text: Ask the visitor to move closer to the wall captions.
options.zh: 請訪客移到離牆上說明更近的地方。
options.whyZh: 往牆邊移動不等於能取得較大字的版本；講者已說可把放大的完整說明送給坐著的訪客。

options.text: Bring an enlarged copy of the full captions from the drawer.
options.zh: 從抽屜拿一份完整說明的放大版給訪客。
options.whyZh: 抽屜裡的版本是完整內容且字體放大，拿給訪客就能在長椅上讀到所有說明。
